style.construction: grounded medieval construction with structurally plausible joins, fastenings, grips, coverage, balance, and weight
style.materialResponse: honest surface wear and material response with one or two physical construction cues; palette alone never establishes material identity; allow at most one bounded supernatural behaviour when the material requires it; secondary materials remain neutral, subordinate, and non-rank-bearing
style.lighting: cold key light with a restrained warm rim
style.background: midnight-charcoal presentation ground with a restrained floor plane

isolatedPresentation.subject: one-complete-object-or-required-pair
isolatedPresentation.commonPose: Use the class anchor for angle, pivot, facing, and camera. Re-scale toward the 8% composition target and never below the 5% hard minimum; establish that corrected occupancy consistently across the class. Present the item upright or on-end; never lie it flat on the floor plane and never mirror the anchor.

fullSetPresentation.subject: empty-self-supporting-armour-set
fullSetPresentation.composition: Full body in a mild three-quarter front view, approximately 15 degrees toward frame-left. Match the anchor facing, stance, pivot, and camera height, then re-scale toward the 8% composition target without crossing the 5% hard minimum. Exactly Head, Torso, Legs, and paired Boots must be readable together.

dependentPiecePresentation.subject: one-matching-object-or-required-pair
dependentPiecePresentation.composition: Isolate the exact accepted component without redesign. Legs means the complete lower-body item or required pair; Boots means one matching pair.

references.purpose: Painterly finish, honest wear, material response, cold key, restrained warm rim, floor, and midnight-charcoal background only; do not transfer Remy or her design.
Sword camera, pivot, facing, and right-leaning diagonal only; re-scale to the v2 framing target and do not transfer Copper material, design, or old framing.
Dagger upright pose, pivot, facing, and diagonal only; re-scale to the v2 framing target and do not transfer Copper material, design, or old framing.
Spear camera, facing, long diagonal, pivot, and head-to-shaft proportion only; re-scale to the v2 framing target and do not transfer Iron material, design, or old framing.
Bow facing, pivot, cant, and draw profile only; keep stave frame-left and string frame-right, and re-scale to the v2 framing target instead of copying old occupancy.
Axe upright-on-end pivot, facing, and slight right diagonal only; re-scale to the v2 framing target and do not transfer Copper material, ornament, or old framing.
Mace upright-on-end pivot, facing, and right diagonal only; lengthen the haft, keep a compact head, and re-scale to the v2 framing target instead of copying proportions or old framing.
Heater-shield camera, upright pivot, facing, and three-quarter presentation only; re-scale to the v2 framing target instead of copying old occupancy.
Staff upright-on-end pivot, facing, and gentle right lean only; re-scale to the v2 framing target and do not transfer Heartwood material, crown design, or old framing.

Full-set facing, mild three-quarter camera, stance, pivot, and camera height only; re-scale to the v2 framing target. Do not copy its support form, body impression, hood void, interior treatment, material, garment design, or old framing.
